# northflank_volume (Data Source)

Looks up a volume in a Northflank project, either by its `id` or by its `name`. Set exactly one of them. Mount paths are not available: the API does not report them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "northflank_volume" "db_data" {
  project_id = "my-application"
  name       = "Postgres Data"
}

output "db_volume_status" {
  value = data.northflank_volume.db_data.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the volume belongs to.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the volume. Set this to look the volume up by ID.
- `name` (String) Name of the volume. Set this to look the volume up by name, which lists the project's volumes to find it.

### Read-Only

- `access_mode` (String) `ReadWriteOnce` or `ReadWriteMany`.
- `attachments` (Attributes Set) Services and jobs the volume is attached to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attachments))
- `created_at` (String) Creation time, in RFC 3339 format.
- `status` (String) Status of the volume on the cluster, such as `BOUND`.
- `storage_class` (String) Storage class of the volume.
- `storage_size` (Number) Size of the volume, in megabytes.
- `uid` (String) Permanent identifier of the volume. Unlike `id`, it never changes and is never reused.

<a id="nestedatt--attachments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attachments`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) ID of the service or job.
- `type` (String) `service` or `job`.
